description: This file defines the Configuration class for AWS SDK's STS regional endpoints. It manages endpoint type configurations and fallback options.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Manages region-specific endpoint configuration for AWS STS, including validation and array serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the configuration with endpoint type and fallback option, validating the endpoint type.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the type of endpoints used (either 'legacy' or 'regional').

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the configuration to an associative array.

methods.name: isFallback
methods.description: Indicates whether fallback mode is enabled.
